requirement.description: Missing implementation for the WebDAV copy operation in handle_post method. The test expects a successful 201 Created response with "k\r\n" body when processing a copy operation, but the current implementation doesn't properly handle the "copy" parameter.
requirement.contract: When a POST request contains a "copy" parameter in the URL query, the HttpCli.handle_post method should process the copy operation and respond with HTTP status 201 Created and a body containing "k\r\n". The copy operation should resolve the destination path correctly and return success as expected by the test.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_cp.py::TestDedup::test - should pass with the copy operation implemented correctly

requirement.description: The PROPFIND handler in HttpCli is returning incorrect content-type header for HTML responses. The test expects to find "text/html; charset=utf-8" but gets "text/html; charset=UTF-8" due to case sensitivity.
requirement.contract: The HttpCli.handle_propfind method should return Content-Type header with consistent casing "text/html; charset=utf-8" for HTML responses to match the expected format in the test.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_webdav.py::TestHttpCli::test - should pass with correct content-type header

requirement.description: The test for directory key functionality is expecting a specific SVG content but receiving different content. The test expects to find ">e403" in the response but finds ">folder" instead, indicating an issue with thumbnail generation for directory keys.
requirement.contract: The HttpCli should properly handle directory key-based requests and return appropriate thumbnails. When accessing a directory key with insufficient permissions, it should return a 403 error with appropriate content (e.g., ">e403") rather than a success response with folder content.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_dots.py::TestDots::test_dk_fk - should pass with correct directory key thumbnail handling
